# Feedback API

> A REST API for collecting, retrieving, filtering, and summarising user feedback. Each feedback item carries a 1–5 star rating, a category (bug / feature / general), a freetext message, and an author handle. All data is persisted in a JSON file.

This API has no authentication. All endpoints accept and return JSON.
Base URL (local dev): http://localhost:3000

## Endpoints

- GET /api/feedback — returns all feedback items, supports query-param filtering
- POST /api/feedback — creates a new feedback item
- GET /api/feedback/:id — returns a single item by UUID
- PUT /api/feedback/:id — partial update (any field)
- DELETE /api/feedback/:id — removes item, returns { deleted: true, id }
- GET /api/feedback/summary — aggregate stats (total, averageRating, byCategory, byRating)
- GET /llms-full.txt — complete agent-readable API reference with schemas and examples

## Optional

- GET /api/health — returns { status: "ok", timestamp }
